hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty'); a='{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow","permissionDecisionReason":"Правка файлов внутри проекта разрешена настройками проекта"}}'; case "$f" in */.claude/settings*.json|*/.claude/hooks/*|*/.env|*/.env.*|*/.ssh/*|*id_rsa*|*/credentials*|*/.aws/*|*/.npmrc|*/.claude.json) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in */memory/*) printf '%s' "$a"; exit 0;; esac; d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; case "$d" in /|"") exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in "$d"/*) printf '%s' "$a";; esac

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); case "$c" in *".claude/settings"*|*".claude/hooks"*|*".claude/agents"*|*".claude/skills"*|*".claude/commands"*|*".env"*|*".ssh"*|*id_rsa*|*credentials*|*".aws"*|*".npmrc"*|*".claude.json"*) exit 0;; esac; case "$c" in *"rm "*|*"shred "*|*"truncate "*|*"mv "*|*"git reset --hard"*|*"--delete"*) exit 0;; esac; printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"allow","permissionDecisionReason":"Команда внутри проекта разрешена настройками проекта"}}'

i=$(cat); f=$(printf '%s' "$i" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.notebook_path // empty'); c=$(printf '%s' "$i" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); a='{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PermissionRequest","permissionDecision":"allow","permissionDecisionReason":"Работа с файлами проекта разрешена настройками проекта"}}'; case "$f$c" in *".claude/settings"*|*".claude/hooks"*|*".env"*|*".ssh"*|*id_rsa*|*credentials*|*".aws"*|*".npmrc"*|*".claude.json"*) exit 0;; esac; case "$c" in *"rm "*|*"shred "*|*"truncate "*|*"git reset --hard"*|*"--delete"*) exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in */memory/*) printf '%s' "$a"; exit 0;; esac; d="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-$PWD}"; case "$d" in /|"") exit 0;; esac; case "$f" in "$d"/*) printf '%s' "$a"; exit 0;; esac; case "$c" in ?*) printf '%s' "$a";; esac
